concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-control-panel-custom-fields]] - Control Panel custom-field configuration route covering Pass Thru versus Store and Pass Back visibility, Add/Edit Processing Options permission, API-setup exclusion, never-used deletion eligibility, and the documented view of ACTIVE Fraud Protection Advanced fields
warnings: Do not conflate configuring a custom-field definition in the Control Panel with passing or returning its data through an API operation.
Preserve the Add/Edit Processing Options permission and the condition that only never-used fields can be deleted.
Fraud Protection Advanced fields are added in its Dashboard; the Control Panel route says the final view shows all ACTIVE fields added there and does not define inactive-field behavior.
Treat the 2026-09-16 raw as collected evidence rather than proof of current support or eligibility.
